question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Find the number on the face opposite the face showing '2'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0bc36381c86783825ec215cb30ea9e7155355b24591216ae071b5ac114a8f1a1.png]
solution:
When we compare the figures 1 and 2, we get:

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/edc9e4b42e297e7f0d37378a951746f2f68a9051b00a9a31645aee1ea0e9a65d.png] 

When dice is rotated such that '3' and '6' are visible in both the cases, we get '2' on the left and '4' on the right which means '2' and '4' are opposite to each other.

So, the face opposite to '2' is '4'**.**

Hence, the correct answer is "**option 1".**
